hypothesis: A frozen A2 obs72 normalization audit can measure channel saturation and preview-time risk across nominal and population-stress current-sim envelopes before any population training validation ranking promotion driver-performance current-sim high-fidelity full-driver repair-success robustness-result feasibility-proof paper or self-ID claim.

parent_objective: execute roadmap A2 as the precondition audit before any population training or high-speed domain extension
blocked_by: none for the audit; any implementation remains a follow-up milestone
supersedes: the A2 OPEN status line in docs/roadmap-phase3-codex-execution.md after the result is documented
invalidates: starting population training without an obs-normalization audit artifact

public_gates: M3221 must use the frozen obs_normalization_prereg.json before the full run
M3221 must report per-channel saturation and per-group worst channels
M3221 must report preview-time risk for the road lookahead contract
M3221 must not apply normalization changes or admit population training
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat advisory recommendations as implemented normalization changes
do not start training from this audit alone
do not claim driver performance from scripted profile observations
do not modify ActiveSafetyReflexDriver, public driver defaults, or checkpoints

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: new obs72 channel saturation and preview-time audit across nominal, C5-wide, and S4-proxy current-sim envelopes
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: Auxiliary measurement only; no normalization change applied, no training admission, no validation ranking promotion, no driver-performance, no high-fidelity sufficiency, no paper, no repair-success, no robustness-result, no feasibility-proof, and no self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if the preregistration file is absent or changed after full-run launch
stop if the quick smoke fails to emit JSON and CSV artifacts
stop if the full audit omits per-channel saturation or preview-time readouts
stop after documenting recommendations; implementation needs a separate milestone
fallback_plan: on script failure, document the failed gate and leave A2 OPEN or BLOCKED with artifact paths
on severe saturation, recommend follow-up implementation but do not apply it in M3221
on clean audit, record that no normalization change is required for the audited envelope
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: Phase-3 roadmap selected A2 after A1 completed in M3220

obs72 channel saturation and preview-time readouts under scripted profiles

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: new obs72 distribution panel across nominal and population-stress current-sim envelopes
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: A2 measurement found a normalization/preview blocker for population or high-speed training; no claim result changes directly
must_synthesize_if: another population-training step is proposed before this audit is documented

success_criteria: experiments/feasibility_audit/obs_normalization_prereg.json exists and predates the full run
experiments/feasibility_audit/obs_normalization_audit.json exists with protocol obs_normalization_audit and quick_mode false
the summary reports saturated channels and preview-time recommendations
the result document states that implementation and training remain separate follow-up milestones
failure_criteria: the full run starts without the preregistration file
the script emits non-finite obs stats or wrong obs72 shape
the summary omits per-channel saturation or preview-time readouts
the milestone applies a normalization change or admits training
the result is described as driver-performance evidence
decision_rule: Accept M3221 as complete only if the full audit artifact and result document exist, report per-channel saturation plus preview-time recommendations, and keep implementation/training blocked.
next_blocker: population or high-speed training remains blocked until a follow-up normalization/preview implementation milestone
